name: transceiver
description: Synchronize selected Codex projects with ChatGPT Web through a bidirectional, provenance-preserving bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Bidirectional Codex and ChatGPT project sync
interface.longDescription: Transceiver sends bounded Codex project handoffs to mapped ChatGPT conversations and bundles a private reverse MCP bridge backed by Codex App Server. Per-project policy controls both directions, and every handoff carries visible agent provenance.
defaultPrompt: Sync this project's current progress to ChatGPT Web.
Report this blocker to the mapped ChatGPT conversation.
Let ChatGPT delegate a read-only task back to Codex.
